name: softprobe-blackbox
description: Investigate Blackbox sessions, OpenTelemetry traces, spans, and logs in Softprobe Explorer, and generate Playwright UI tests from recorded sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Debug agent sessions and generate UI tests from Explorer
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Softprobe Explorer via hosted MCP to search sessions, inspect OpenTelemetry traces, spans, and logs, provision project telemetry, and turn recorded browser sessions into Playwright and @softprobe/e2e tests.
defaultPrompt: Use Blackbox get_session_semantic_actions on a recorded session and write a Playwright + @softprobe/e2e UI test
Use Blackbox to diagnose why my latest failing session errored
Bootstrap Blackbox telemetry for this project
